title: Competitive teardown and comparison matrix
description: Compares competitors using cited product, market, pricing, and experience evidence.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: competitive-teardown-comparison
  title: Competitive teardown and comparison matrix
  description: Compares competitors using cited product, market, pricing, and experience evidence.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a decision-ready, evidence-backed competitive comparison.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - strategy-owner
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Competitors and comparison dimensions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - competitors
          - dimensions
          - sources
        x-ladder-input-mode: mixed
    - id: research
      kind: agent
      name: Gather competitor evidence
      role: Competitive intelligence analyst
      prompt: Collect current evidence for each competitor and dimension. Separate facts, inference, and unknowns.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - research
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: matrix
      name: Build comparison matrix
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Competitive comparison analyst
      prompt: Build an evidence-backed matrix across every competitor and declared dimension. Preserve citations, observation
        dates, unknowns, and confidence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: insights
      kind: agent
      name: Derive strategic implications
      role: Strategy analyst
      prompt: Identify differentiation, vulnerabilities, white space, and recommended actions without overstating evidence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: strategy-owner
      kind: approval
      name: Strategy owner approves findings
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Competitive teardown, comparison matrix, and actions
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: research
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: research
      to: matrix
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: matrix
      to: insights
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: insights
      to: strategy-owner
      kind: dependency
    - id: e5
      from: strategy-owner
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
